new.eligibilitySummary: Dogs with idiopathic epilepsy who have tried two or more anti-seizure medications and experience two or more seizures per month, with a 6-month seizure log, are eligible for this study of transcutaneous vagus nerve stimulation.
new.eligibilityDetails: Inclusion criteria: Diagnosis of idiopathic epilepsy; Already tried two or more anti-seizure medications; Two or more seizures a month; Kept seizure log dating back 6-months. Exclusion criteria: Medical conditions, aside from IE, affecting brain or heart health, breathing, or skin on the neck; Recent anti-seizure medication (ASM) changes or plans to change ASM regimen in the next 6-months

eligibilityDetails.old: Dogs >1 year old and 10–50 kg in body weight; Naïve, untreated B‑cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology or histology with immunophenotyping (flow cytometry); At least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm in longest diameter; WHO stage II, III, or IV B‑cell lymphoma; Adequate organ function on bloodwork and urinalysis; Performance score of 0–1 (normal to mildly decreased activity) and life expectancy ≥1 month; Owner consent. Key exclusions: T‑cell lymphoma or involvement of skin, GI tract, or nervous system; Internal‑only disease (mediastinum, liver, spleen) without peripheral lymph node enlargement; Prior lymphoma treatment (chemotherapy, Tanovea, Laverdia, radiation) or long‑term corticosteroids (>2 weeks); Hypercalcemia, MDR1 deficiency, pregnancy/lactation, or concurrent trial enrollment.
eligibilityDetails.new: Dogs >1 year old and 10–50 kg in body weight; Naïve, untreated B‑cell lymphoma confirmed by cytology or histology with immunophenotyping (flow cytometry); At least two peripheral lymph nodes ≥2 cm in longest diameter; WHO stage II, III, or IV B‑cell lymphoma; Adequate organ function on bloodwork and urinalysis; Performance score of 0–1 (normal to mildly decreased activity) and life expectancy ≥1 month; Owner consent. Exclusions: T‑cell lymphoma or involvement of skin, GI tract, or nervous system; Internal‑only disease (mediastinum, liver, spleen) without peripheral lymph node enlargement; Prior lymphoma treatment (chemotherapy, Tanovea, Laverdia, radiation) or long‑term corticosteroids (>2 weeks); Hypercalcemia, MDR1 deficiency, pregnancy/lactation, or concurrent trial enrollment.
